verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a product-catalog API that aggregates retailers. A merchant self-serve enablement path is therefore a fair question for it, but the evidence documents only developer- and agent-side access: API keys, MCP, UCP, SDK, CLI and MPP payments. Nothing shows a merchant enabling a setting, signing an agreement, or publishing an endpoint to start receiving agent traffic, and the affiliate payouts are paid to developers, not merchants.

support.subject: As a merchant, I have a documented self-serve path to start accepting agent traffic — enable a setting, sign an agreement, or publish an endpoint
